instruction.text: Matthew plays percussion in his school orchestra, and his triangle has the lengths, 4.27 inches, 3.9 inches and 5.95 inches. Use Pythagoras’ Theorem to determine whether Matthew’s triangle has a right angle?
Does the triangle a right angle?
A triangular slice of toast has the lengths, 10.4 centimetres, 18.5 centimetres and 15.3 centimetres. Use Pythagoras’ Theorem to determine whether the slice of toast has a right angle?
Does the slice of toast have a right angle?
A room with a triangular window has the dimensions 0.6 metres, 0.91 metres and 0.98 metres. Use Pythagoras’ Theorem to determine whether the window has a right angle?
Does the window have a right angle?
A park has three sides with the lengths 2.93 kilometres, 0.68 kilometres and 2.85 kilometres. Use Pythagoras’ Theorem to determine whether the park has a right angle?
Does the park have a right angle?
